Sebuah taman berbentuk gabungan persegi panjang (12 m × 8 m) dan setengah lingkaran dengan diameter 8 m. Berapa luas taman seluruhnya? (π = 3,14)
soal.pembahasan: Luas persegi panjang = 12 × 8 = 96 m². Luas setengah lingkaran = ½ × π × r² = ½ × 3,14 × 4² = ½ × 3,14 × 16 = 25,12 m². Total = 96 + 25,12 = 121,12 m².

soal.teks: Pada peta skala 1:300.000, seorang siswa mengukur jarak kota A ke kota B adalah 7,5 cm. Berapa jarak sebenarnya dalam km?
Sebuah proyek diselesaikan 6 pekerja dalam 12 hari. Berapa hari yang dibutuhkan jika pekerjanya ditambah menjadi 9 orang?
soal.pembahasan: Ini adalah perbandingan berbalik nilai. 6 pekerja × 12 hari = 72 hari-orang. Dengan 9 pekerja: 72 ÷ 9 = 8 hari.

soal.teks: Sebuah foto berukuran 4 cm × 6 cm akan diperbesar secara proporsional sehingga lebarnya menjadi 15 cm. Berapa panjang foto setelah diperbesar?
soal.pembahasan: Lebar diperbesar dari 6 cm menjadi 15 cm, faktor perbesaran = 15 ÷ 6 = 2,5. Panjang baru = 4 × 2,5 = 10 cm.

soal.teks: Andi bersepeda dari rumah ke sekolah dengan kecepatan 12 km/jam dan tiba dalam 20 menit. Berapa km jarak rumah ke sekolah?
soal.pembahasan: Waktu = 20 menit = 20/60 jam = 1/3 jam. Jarak = kecepatan × waktu = 12 × 1/3 = 4 km.

soal.teks: Sebuah pipa mengalirkan air ke tangki dengan debit 0,5 m³/menit. Tangki berbentuk balok berukuran panjang 3 m, lebar 2 m, dan tinggi 2 m. Berapa menit untuk mengisi tangki hingga penuh?
soal.pembahasan: Volume tangki = 3 × 2 × 2 = 12 m³. Waktu = volume ÷ debit = 12 m³ ÷ 0,5 m³/menit = 24 menit.

soal.teks: Sebuah bangun datar memiliki keliling 48 cm. Jika bangun itu berbentuk persegi, berapa luasnya?
soal.pembahasan: Sisi persegi = 48 ÷ 4 = 12 cm. Luas = 12² = 144 cm².

soal.teks: Campuran cat terdiri dari cat biru dan putih dengan perbandingan 2 : 5. Jika cat putih yang tersedia 35 liter, berapa liter cat biru yang diperlukan?
soal.pembahasan: Perbandingan biru : putih = 2 : 5. Jika putih = 35, maka 5 bagian = 35 → 1 bagian = 7. Cat biru = 2 bagian = 2 × 7 = 14 liter.

soal.teks: Jarak dua kota sebenarnya 120 km. Pada peta, jarak tersebut adalah 4 cm. Tentukan skala peta tersebut!
soal.pembahasan: Jarak sebenarnya = 120 km = 12.000.000 cm. Skala = jarak peta : jarak sebenarnya = 4 : 12.000.000 = 1 : 3.000.000.

soal.teks: Apa yang dimaksud dengan kalimat pasif dan bagaimana cirinya? Ubah kalimat aktif ini menjadi pasif: 'Guru memberikan hadiah kepada siswa berprestasi.'
soal.jawaban: Kalimat pasif: subjeknya dikenai pekerjaan, predikat berawalan di- atau ter-. Pasifnya: 'Hadiah diberikan oleh guru kepada siswa berprestasi.'
alternatif_jawaban: Hadiah diberikan guru kepada siswa berprestasi.
soal.pembahasan: Kalimat aktif: subjek melakukan pekerjaan (predikat ber-me-). Kalimat pasif: subjek dikenai pekerjaan (predikat ber-di-/ter-). Cara mengubah: objek aktif → subjek pasif, tambah 'di-' pada predikat, subjek aktif → keterangan pelaku (oleh...).

soal.teks: Identifikasi SPOK kalimat: 'Dengan semangat tinggi, para atlet nasional bertanding di Olimpiade Paris.'
soal.jawaban: S: para atlet nasional, P: bertanding, K cara: dengan semangat tinggi, K tempat: di Olimpiade Paris
alternatif_jawaban: S=para atlet nasional P=bertanding K=dengan semangat tinggi, di Olimpiade Paris
soal.pembahasan: Kalimat ini berpola KSP K (keterangan di awal). S: para atlet nasional (subjek). P: bertanding (predikat intransitif, tidak perlu objek). K cara: dengan semangat tinggi. K tempat: di Olimpiade Paris.

soal.teks: Apa perbedaan penggunaan 'dan' dengan 'tetapi' dalam kalimat? Berikan contoh masing-masing!
soal.jawaban: 'Dan' menghubungkan dua hal yang sejenis/setara (aditif). 'Tetapi' menghubungkan dua hal yang bertentangan (adversatif). Contoh: 'Dia pintar dan rajin.' vs 'Dia pintar tetapi malas.'
soal.pembahasan: 'Dan' = konjungsi koordinatif aditif: menambahkan informasi yang sejalan. 'Tetapi' = konjungsi koordinatif adversatif: mempertentangkan dua hal yang berlawanan. Keduanya menghubungkan dua klausa sederajat tapi dengan hubungan makna yang berbeda.

soal.teks: Kalimat 'Badai pasti berlalu' digunakan sebagai ungkapan bahwa masalah pasti akan selesai. Majas apa yang digunakan?
soal.pembahasan: Alegori adalah perluasan metafora yang menggunakan kiasan secara panjang untuk menyampaikan makna tersirat. 'Badai' = masalah, 'berlalu' = akan selesai. Alegori sering berupa cerita atau ungkapan yang memiliki makna tersembunyi di balik makna harfiahnya.

soal.teks: Kata 'merah' dalam 'meja merah' dan 'meja hijau' memiliki makna berbeda. Apa makna 'meja hijau'?
soal.jawaban: Meja hijau bermakna konotasi: pengadilan atau sidang pengadilan
soal.pembahasan: 'Meja hijau' adalah ungkapan konotatif yang bermakna pengadilan (karena dahulu meja hakim berwarna hijau). Contoh: 'Tersangka korupsi itu akan dibawa ke meja hijau.' Makna denotasinya: meja berwarna hijau.

soal.teks: Kapan tanda hubung (-) digunakan? Berikan dua contoh!
soal.jawaban: 1) Menghubungkan kata ulang: anak-anak, sayur-mayur. 2) Menghubungkan imbuhan dengan nama diri/angka: di-PHK, tahun 1945-an
alternatif_jawaban: Kata ulang dan imbuhan dengan nama/angka
soal.pembahasan: Tanda hubung (-) digunakan: (1) dalam kata ulang: buku-buku, rumah-rumah, (2) imbuhan + kata asing/nama diri: di-PHK, pro-demokrasi, (3) menyambung suku kata di akhir baris, (4) angka tahun: tahun 1945-an, halaman 10–25, (5) kata gabung: surat-menyurat.

soal.teks: Apakah nama-nama planet dan benda langit ditulis dengan huruf kapital? Berikan contoh!
soal.jawaban: Ya. Contoh: Planet Mars, Bintang Sirius, Galaksi Bima Sakti, Satelit Bulan
alternatif_jawaban: Ya, contoh: Mars, Bulan, Bima Sakti
soal.pembahasan: Nama planet, bintang, satelit, dan benda langit ditulis dengan huruf kapital karena merupakan nama diri. Contoh: Planet Merkurius, Jupiter, Saturnus, Bulan (satelit Bumi), Matahari, Galaksi Bima Sakti. Namun 'matahari' dan 'bulan' ditulis kecil jika tidak merujuk nama diri (misalnya 'cahaya bulan').

soal.teks: Apa perbedaan makna antara 'memukul' dan 'dipukul'? Imbuhan apa yang membedakannya?
soal.jawaban: 'Memukul' (imbuhan me-) = kalimat aktif, subjek melakukan pukulan. 'Dipukul' (imbuhan di-) = kalimat pasif, subjek dikenai pukulan
soal.pembahasan: Imbuhan me- membentuk kata kerja aktif (subjek melakukan): saya memukul bola. Imbuhan di- membentuk kata kerja pasif (subjek dikenai tindakan): bola dipukul (oleh saya). Perbedaan ini mengubah konstruksi kalimat secara fundamental.

soal.teks: Kalimat 'Buku itu sangat amat menarik sekali.' tidak efektif. Mengapa? Perbaiki!
soal.jawaban: Karena 'sangat', 'amat', dan 'sekali' memiliki makna sama (menyatakan tingkat sangat) sehingga mubazir. Perbaikan: 'Buku itu sangat menarik.' atau 'Buku itu menarik sekali.'
alternatif_jawaban: Mubazir: sangat-amat-sekali bermakna sama. Perbaikan: Buku itu sangat menarik.
soal.pembahasan: Kemubaziran adalah penggunaan dua kata atau lebih yang bermakna sama secara bersamaan. 'Sangat', 'amat', dan 'sekali' semuanya menyatakan tingkat superlatif. Cukup gunakan salah satu: 'sangat menarik' atau 'menarik sekali'.

soal.teks: Apa kepanjangan dari 'POLRI' dan 'TNI'?
soal.jawaban: POLRI: Kepolisian Negara Republik Indonesia. TNI: Tentara Nasional Indonesia
alternatif_jawaban: Polri = Kepolisian Negara RI; TNI = Tentara Nasional Indonesia
soal.pembahasan: POLRI (Kepolisian Negara Republik Indonesia) bertugas menjaga keamanan dan ketertiban masyarakat. TNI (Tentara Nasional Indonesia) terdiri dari TNI Angkatan Darat (AD), TNI Angkatan Laut (AL), dan TNI Angkatan Udara (AU).

soal.teks: Majas litotes adalah majas yang merendahkan diri. Manakah contoh majas litotes yang benar?
soal.jawaban: 'Mampirlah ke gubuk kami yang sederhana ini.' (padahal rumahnya mewah)
alternatif_jawaban: Mampir ke gubuk kami (padahal rumah mewah)
soal.pembahasan: Litotes adalah majas yang merendahkan kenyataan yang sesungguhnya, biasanya untuk sopan santun atau merendah. 'Gubuk sederhana' padahal rumah mewah adalah litotes. Kebalikan litotes adalah hiperbola (melebih-lebihkan).

soal.teks: Perbaiki penggunaan tanda baca pada kalimat berikut: 'Toko itu menjual: beras, gula pasir, minyak goreng, dan tepung terigu.'
soal.jawaban: 'Toko itu menjual beras, gula pasir, minyak goreng, dan tepung terigu.' (tanda titik dua dihapus karena perincian langsung mengikuti predikat)
soal.pembahasan: Tanda titik dua tidak digunakan jika perincian langsung mengikuti predikat atau kata yang memerlukan perincian. Salah: 'menjual: beras, gula...'. Benar: 'menjual beras, gula...' ATAU tanda titik dua dipakai jika ada kata pengantar yang menggantungkan: 'Barang yang dijual: beras, gula...'

soal.teks: What do you call the place in school where students can eat their meals during break time?
soal.pembahasan: A 'canteen' (British English) or 'cafeteria' (American English) is the place in a school where students buy and eat their food during break or lunch time. In Indonesian, it is called 'kantin'.

soal.teks: What do you call the room where the family spends time together, watches TV, and receives guests?
soal.jawaban: Living room (or sitting room / family room)
soal.pembahasan: A 'living room' (or 'sitting room') is a room in a house where people relax, socialize, watch TV, and receive guests. In Indonesian, it is called 'ruang tamu' (for guests) or 'ruang keluarga' (for family). These may be separate rooms.

soal.teks: What is the difference between 'boiled', 'fried', and 'grilled' food? Give an example of each.
soal.jawaban: Boiled = cooked in hot water (boiled egg). Fried = cooked in hot oil (fried chicken). Grilled = cooked over open heat/fire (grilled fish)
soal.pembahasan: Cooking methods: 'boiled' (direbus) = cooked in boiling water; 'fried' (digoreng) = cooked in oil; 'grilled' (dipanggang/dibakar) = cooked on a grill over direct heat; 'steamed' (dikukus) = cooked with steam; 'baked' (dipanggang di oven) = cooked in oven.

soal.teks: What is a 'uniform' and in what situations do people usually wear one?
soal.jawaban: A uniform is a set of standardized clothing worn by members of a group. People wear uniforms at school, in the military, police, hospitals, and some workplaces
alternatif_jawaban: Seragam; dipakai di sekolah, militer, rumah sakit, dll.
soal.pembahasan: A 'uniform' (seragam) is a specific set of clothes required to be worn by members of an organization. Examples: school uniform (seragam sekolah), police uniform (seragam polisi), nurse uniform (seragam perawat), sports kit (seragam olahraga).

soal.teks: What are the months that have only 30 days?
soal.pembahasan: Months with 30 days: April, June, September, November. Months with 31 days: January, March, May, July, August, October, December. February has 28 days (29 in a leap year). A helpful rhyme: 'Thirty days hath September, April, June, and November...'

soal.teks: Indonesia does not have four seasons like countries in Europe. What two seasons does Indonesia have and when do they occur?
soal.jawaban: Indonesia has the dry season (musim kemarau, around April–September) and the rainy/wet season (musim hujan, around October–March)
soal.pembahasan: As a tropical country near the equator, Indonesia has two seasons: the dry season (musim kemarau) roughly from April to September, and the rainy/wet season (musim hujan) roughly from October to March. The exact timing varies by region.

soal.teks: What do you call a person who writes news articles for newspapers, magazines, or websites?
soal.pembahasan: A 'journalist' or 'reporter' is a person who researches and writes news stories for newspapers, magazines, TV, radio, or online media. In Indonesian, it is called 'jurnalis' or 'wartawan'. Related: 'editor' (edits articles), 'photographer' (takes photos for news).

soal.teks: What is the English term for a situation when prices are reduced in a shop, often happening after a holiday or end of season?
soal.pembahasan: A 'sale' is when a shop reduces the prices of its products, often to clear stock or attract customers. 'Discount' means a reduction from the original price. 'Clearance sale' is when leftover items are sold at very low prices. In Indonesian: 'diskon' or 'obral'.

soal.teks: What do you call an animal that only eats plants?
soal.pembahasan: An 'herbivore' is an animal that only eats plants. Examples: cow, horse, rabbit, deer, elephant, giraffe. A 'carnivore' eats only meat (lion, tiger). An 'omnivore' eats both plants and meat (bear, human, pig). In Indonesian: herbivora, karnivora, omnivora.

soal.teks: What do you say to a taxi or ride-hailing driver when you want to go somewhere?
soal.jawaban: Please take me to [destination]. / Can you drive me to [destination]? / I'd like to go to [destination], please.
soal.pembahasan: Common phrases when taking a taxi or ride: 'Please take me to Soekarno-Hatta Airport.' / 'Can you drive me to the nearest hospital?' / 'I need to go to the train station.' Always mention your destination clearly.

soal.teks: What do you call your spouse's parents (your husband's or wife's parents)?
soal.pembahasan: Your spouse's parents are called 'parents-in-law': father-in-law (mertua laki-laki) and mother-in-law (mertua perempuan). Your spouse's siblings are brothers/sisters-in-law. The suffix '-in-law' indicates a family relationship by marriage.

soal.teks: What is the English word for the area outside the front of a house, often with a roof, where people can sit?
soal.pembahasan: A 'porch' is a covered entrance area at the front of a house. A 'veranda' is a roofed platform along the outside of a house. A 'terrace' can be an outdoor area or a row of houses. In Indonesian, all can be translated as 'beranda' or 'teras'.

soal.teks: What is a 'vegetarian'? What types of food do they eat and avoid?
soal.jawaban: A vegetarian is a person who does not eat meat (or fish). They eat fruits, vegetables, grains, dairy products, and eggs, but avoid meat, poultry, and seafood
alternatif_jawaban: Orang yang tidak makan daging; makan sayur, buah, susu, telur
soal.pembahasan: A 'vegetarian' (vegetaris) avoids meat, poultry, and sometimes fish. A 'vegan' avoids all animal products including dairy and eggs. A 'pescatarian' avoids meat but eats fish. In Indonesian, 'vegetarian' is the same word, and 'pantang makan daging' means 'avoids eating meat'.

soal.teks: What is the English word for the piece of furniture that students sit at to study in a classroom?
soal.pembahasan: A 'desk' is a table used for writing and studying. A 'school desk' has a flat surface for writing and sometimes a shelf underneath. Students sit on a 'chair' next to the desk. The teacher's desk is called a 'teacher's desk' or 'podium'. In Indonesian: 'meja belajar'.

soal.teks: What weather warning word is used when a storm, flood, or other danger is happening right now and you must take action immediately?
soal.pembahasan: Weather warning levels: 'Watch' = conditions are possible, be prepared. 'Warning' = dangerous conditions are occurring or imminent, take action now. 'Advisory' = less serious but still potentially hazardous. In Indonesian emergencies: 'peringatan bahaya' or 'siaga darurat'.

soal.teks: What is the word for the type of clothing that covers both legs separately, from the waist down, commonly worn by both men and women?
soal.pembahasan: 'Trousers' (British) or 'pants' (American) is a garment covering both legs from the waist down. 'Jeans' are trousers made of denim. 'Shorts' are a shorter version. In Indonesian: 'celana panjang' (long trousers) or 'celana pendek' (shorts).

soal.teks: What do you call a person who repairs and maintains electrical systems and appliances?
soal.pembahasan: An 'electrician' is a skilled tradesperson who installs and maintains electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures. In Indonesian: 'teknisi listrik' or 'tukang listrik'. Related jobs: plumber (tukang ledeng), carpenter (tukang kayu), mechanic (montir).

soal.teks: In a clothing store, what does 'try on' mean?
soal.jawaban: To put on clothing to see if it fits and looks good before buying it
soal.pembahasan: 'To try on' means to put on a piece of clothing temporarily to check if it fits. Example: 'Can I try on this jacket?' → 'Of course, the fitting room is over there.' A 'fitting room' or 'changing room' (kamar pas) is the private room where you try on clothes.

soal.teks: If your father remarries and has a new wife, what do you call that woman in relation to you?
soal.pembahasan: A 'stepmother' is the woman who is married to your father but is not your biological mother. Similarly: 'stepfather' (ibu menikah lagi), 'stepbrother/stepsister' (saudara tiri). The prefix 'step-' indicates a family relationship through remarriage.

soal.teks: What is the English word for animals that are active at night and sleep during the day?
soal.pembahasan: 'Nocturnal' animals are active at night and rest during the day. Examples: owl (burung hantu), bat (kelelawar), raccoon, hedgehog. Animals active during the day are called 'diurnal' (hewan yang aktif siang hari), like most birds and humans.

soal.teks: When you miss your bus or train, what do you say?
soal.jawaban: I missed the bus/train. When is the next one? / I'm sorry, I missed my train.
alternatif_jawaban: I missed the bus. When is the next one?
soal.pembahasan: Useful transportation phrases: 'I missed the bus/train.' = Saya ketinggalan bis/kereta. 'When is the next bus?' = Kapan bis berikutnya? 'Which platform does the train to Surabaya leave from?' = Dari peron berapa kereta ke Surabaya?

soal.teks: How do you say 'on Monday' and 'in January' in English? Why is there a difference in preposition?
soal.jawaban: 'On Monday' uses 'on' for days. 'In January' uses 'in' for months and years. Rule: on + days/dates; in + months/years/seasons; at + specific time
alternatif_jawaban: On Monday (hari), in January (bulan) — preposisi berbeda untuk hari vs bulan
soal.pembahasan: Time prepositions: AT (specific time: at 7 o'clock, at noon), ON (days and dates: on Monday, on 17 August), IN (months, years, seasons, longer periods: in January, in 2024, in summer). This is a key grammar rule for talking about time in English.

soal.teks: What does 'out of stock' mean in a shop?
soal.jawaban: It means the item is not available because all of it has been sold and there is no more left in the shop
soal.pembahasan: 'Out of stock' means the product is currently not available because it has all been sold. The opposite is 'in stock' (tersedia). Related phrases: 'available' (tersedia), 'sold out' (terjual habis), 'back order' (dipesan untuk pengiriman berikutnya).

soal.teks: What is the English term for the protective shell on a turtle's back?
soal.pembahasan: A turtle's 'shell' is its hard protective covering made of bone and keratin. The top part is called the 'carapace' and the bottom is the 'plastron'. A turtle cannot be removed from its shell — it is part of its skeleton. In Indonesian: 'cangkang kura-kura'.

soal.teks: What do you call a person whose job is to grow crops and raise animals on a farm?
soal.pembahasan: A 'farmer' is a person who manages and works on a farm, growing crops (tanaman) or raising livestock (ternak). In Indonesian: 'petani' (crop farmer) or 'peternak' (livestock farmer). Related: 'fisherman' (nelayan), 'gardener' (tukang kebun).

soal.teks: What is the English word for the activity where a teacher reads out words for students to spell correctly on paper?
soal.pembahasan: A 'dictation' is an exercise where the teacher reads a text aloud and students write what they hear, testing listening and spelling skills. A 'spelling test' is when students must spell words correctly. In Indonesian: 'dikte' (dictation) or 'tes ejaan' (spelling test).

soal.teks: What do you call the machine in the kitchen that keeps food cold to prevent it from spoiling?
soal.pembahasan: A 'refrigerator' (or 'fridge' in informal English) is the kitchen appliance that keeps food cold at around 4°C and frozen food at -18°C. In Indonesian: 'kulkas' (from 'koelkast', Dutch for 'cold cabinet'). Related: 'freezer' (pembeku/laci beku).

soal.teks: What do you call the person who officially controls and guides the flight of an airplane from the ground?
soal.pembahasan: An 'air traffic controller' (pengatur lalu lintas udara) works in a control tower at an airport and uses radar to guide aircraft safely in the air and on the ground. They communicate with pilots to prevent collisions and manage takeoffs and landings.
